card: Owner blind read that records its verdict: capture, unblind, report
guards: case 7 (side assignment equals committed blind-source-map.json) and case 8 (six <article> inner HTMLs of OWNER-READ.html hash to the pre-form page, sha256 ce2eacb3...) pin behaviour that must not change; red before only because blind-pair.ts did not exist
deviations_from_card: Critic case 8 failed on the first try because of planner drift: re-planning at HEAD changes morning 2's planner-side article (Brennic's line). As the critic said, the form is injected into the committed mornings instead: blind.ts --keep-mornings pulls the six articles out of the committed page and renders the form around them; the map is left untouched (the fresh re-plan path still writes the identical map). pageHash is sha256 of the six article inner HTMLs, not of the whole file, since the page holds its own hash (data-page). Answers are bound to the mornings that were read, and a chrome-only re-render keeps them valid. report.ts cannot run on this host (.director-runtime/cost-ledger.json is missing, and it also drifts fuzz.json/judge-examples.json, which I reverted), so W1-report.md's one line was updated by hand to exactly what report.ts now emits for a pending result ('Owner blind read: pending. Nothing is labelled felt.'), and a test pins W1-report.md to ownerReadLine(readOwnerResult()). Commit order is feat, feat, test so that each commit compiles. Added test 10: a saved file for the real committed page is scored end to end through the committed map.
notes: package.json: the 'blind:score' script was added at the end of scripts under the lock and committed in 8c0a240; the lock was released. The page's inline exporter (EXPORT_SOURCE) is checked against the TS exportResponses via new Function. blind-check.ts (Playwright) was not run, because browsers are forbidden. Its 3-section, 6-article and no-label checks are asserted in vitest on the committed page. The first full gate was red only on sibling in-flight core-census files (census-kit.test.ts, report-counters.ts tsc). The re-run about 75 s later was green: 104 files, 835 tests, exit 0. owner-read-result.json does not exist yet, so the owner read stays pending until the owner saves answers and someone runs npm run blind:score -- owner-read-responses.json.
